_provenance.note: Stand-in for a recorded inference run. Regenerate with `uv run python -m udc.demo record` (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).

mappings.reasoning: Handle is a URL slug shared by variants, not a variant identifier.
Variant SKU uniquely identifies each sellable variant.
Title is the customer-facing product name.
Product type holds merchandise categories such as Bags and Shoes.
Variant price is the current selling price.
Compare-at price is the pre-discount price; the core model has no field for it.
Option 1 holds colours for some products (Black, Navy) but sizes for others (40, 38).
Option 2 holds sizes for some products (One Size) but colours for others (Brown, Camel).
Inventory quantity is the stock available to sell.
